abrotonum-foemina.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [39]; image 543716
abrotonum-foemina.description: A single tall upright stem rises from a short, many-branched root at the bottom; its lower half is bare and its upper half carries a narrow plume of side branches with finely divided leaves and small round button-like flower heads at the tips. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Fuchs, De historia stirpium: Abrotonum foemina (scan [39])

abrotonum-foemina.title: Abrotonum foemina, upright flowering stem
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Very tall and narrow (about 1:2.9); suits a margin or the side of a text column.

alsine-media.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [54]; image 543731
alsine-media.description: Common chickweed (Stellaria media), a loose sprawling tuft of thin trailing stems that spread upward and outward from a small fibrous root at the bottom centre, set with pairs of small toothed oval leaves and tiny five-petalled flowers and buds at the tips; the tuft is wider at the top than at the root. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Fuchs, De historia stirpium: Alsine media (scan [54])

alsine-media.quality: A few stray scan specks sit beside the leaf tips, mostly at the right.
alsine-media.title: Alsine media, chickweed tuft
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The upper two thirds crop to a loose scatter of leafy stems without the root.

anagallis-mas.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [50]; image 543727
anagallis-mas.description: Scarlet pimpernel (Anagallis mas, the red-flowered pimpernel), a trailing plant whose thin stems arch up and outward from a fibrous root at the lower left, carrying pairs of pointed oval leaves, open five-petalled flowers and many round buds and seed capsules on short stalks; the arching stems leave open space in the middle. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Fuchs, De historia stirpium: Anagallis mas (scan [50])

anagallis-mas.quality: A few stray scan specks remain near the top edge and beside the flowers.
anagallis-mas.title: Anagallis mas, pimpernel sprig
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Nearly square, with the root tucked in the lower left; crops well to the upper arch of stems and flowers.

chamaemelum-eranthemon.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [59]; image 543736
chamaemelum-eranthemon.description: An upright branching plant with a long slender root that takes up the lower third, whorls of narrow linear leaves along the thin stems, and about a dozen five-petalled flowers with hanging, parted petals at the branch tips; the crown spreads wider than the stem below it. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Fuchs, De historia stirpium: Chamaemelum eranthemon (scan [59])

chamaemelum-eranthemon.title: Chamaemelum eranthemon, flowering branch
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The long bare root can be cropped at the stem base for a shorter, airier piece.

plantago-maior.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [69]; image 543746
plantago-maior.description: Greater plantain (Plantago major), a rosette of six broad ribbed oval leaves on long stalks spreading left and right from a tangle of fibrous roots at the centre, with three tall narrow flower spikes rising from the middle; one leaf hangs down below the root. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Fuchs, De historia stirpium: Plantago maior (scan [69])

plantago-maior.title: Plantago maior, greater plantain
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The lowest leaf hangs below the root; crop it off at the root for a compact rosette with the spikes.

sedum-maius.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [64]; image 543741
sedum-maius.description: Common houseleek (Sempervivum tectorum), a rosette of fleshy pointed leaves at the base over a thick root and trailing runners, from which a tall column-like stem densely clad in overlapping leaves rises and opens at the top into a crown of curled, spreading branches bearing many small star-shaped flowers; the whole reads as a symmetrical upright emblem. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Fuchs, De historia stirpium: Sedum maius (scan [64])

sedum-maius.title: Sedum maius, houseleek in flower
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Keep root, rosette and flower crown together; the piece is built as one vertical emblem.

seriphium-absinthium.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [34]; image 543711
seriphium-absinthium.description: A wormwood (Artemisia), three tall upright shoots rising from a thick twisted root at the lower right, each densely set from base to tip with finely divided feathery leaves; the shoots lean slightly apart and fill a tall rectangle with little open space. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.

provenance.object_title: Fuchs, De historia stirpium: Seriphium absinthium (scan [34])

seriphium-absinthium.quality: Three small round ink blots remain, on the upper-right shoot and near the base of the stems.
seriphium-absinthium.title: Seriphium absinthium, wormwood bush
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Dense foliage; reads as a textured block beside text rather than as a silhouette.
